messages:
joel: quick thought: the mini-rewind CTA under each timeline item feels hidden on mobile. screenshot: https://redwood.internal/img/mini-rewind.png

marta: agree. on mobile we should surface it as a small pill next to the timestamp rather than buried in the overflow menu. keeps actions discoverable.

aria: accessibility: pills must have descriptive aria-labels, e.g. 'Rewind to snapshot: checkout-service v3, created 4m ago'. also ensure tappable area >= 44px.

sam: copy: use 'Rewind' (verb) instead of 'Undo' to avoid confusion with snapshot undo vs deploy rollback. Add a confirmation toast: 'Rewind queued 1 service will use v3' with undo link.

kevin: implementation: swapping pill placement is straightforward, but watch for layout shift on narrow screens. We'll reserve space so items don't jump when the pill appears. Also add a short debounce on taps to prevent double-requests.

marta: visual: small outline + icon (rewind) then 'Rewind' label on wide, icon-only on narrow. contrast needs to be 3:1 at min for small text.

aria: also add keyboard focus for the pill and announce: 'Rewind to snapshot started. Press undo to cancel.' keep live-region messages concise.

joel: plan: I'll update the comps (desktop + 375px) and post PNGs. kevin, can you add the debounce + toast in the spike?

kevin: yep, will do a feature flagged PR and wire telemetry for 'rewind_initiated' and 'rewind_undo'. ETA: 48hrs.

sam: thanks all, prefer to ship as opt-in to test with a handful of customers first. :thumbsup:
